The hit comedy manga comes to print by popular demand! Swimsuits! Ramen! Dumb jokes! Beer! Uncomfortable nudity!

GO SOUTH, YOUNG MAN

Having raised their funds for the diving license boot camp, Iori and the gang finally make their way to Okinawa. But their joy is short-lived, as what awaits them there is the bane of all morons: an exam. To combat this dread, the antics of this nudity-loving diving club are only going to escalate in response!
